title: Sum-check single round: transport the simple verifier's knowledge soundness to the lifted oracle verifier
intent: Prove round-by-round knowledge soundness of the full single-round oracle verifier by first rewriting it to its context-lifted form, then instantiating the general transport theorem OracleVerifier.liftContext_rbrKnowledgeSoundness with the simple round's certificate and the lens's knowledge-soundness certificate.

parent.name: oracleVerifier_rbrKnowledgeSoundness
parent.statement:
theorem oracleVerifier_rbrKnowledgeSoundness [Fintype R] [IsDomain R] :
    (oracleVerifier R n deg D oSpec i).toVerifier.rbrKnowledgeSoundness init impl
    (relationRound R n deg D i.castSucc) (relationRound R n deg D i.succ)
    (fun _ => (deg : ℝ≥0) / Fintype.card R)
parent.note: Fully qualified name Sumcheck.Spec.SingleRound.oracleVerifier_rbrKnowledgeSoundness (the Security section's oracle-verifier round); not to be confused with the child of the same short name in namespace Simple.

children.name: oracleVerifier_eq_liftContext
children.statement:
theorem oracleVerifier_eq_liftContext (i : Fin n) :
    oracleVerifier R n deg D oSpec i =
      (Simple.oracleVerifier R deg D oSpec).liftContext
        (oStmtExecutableLens R n deg D i) (liftContextOutput R n deg D oSpec i)
children.closed_by: apply OracleVerifier.ext, then induction oa using OracleComp.inductionOn (the query case cites Simple.oracleVerifier_only_message_queries)
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: The full round's oracle verifier equals the simple oracle verifier context-lifted along the executable oracle-statement lens

children.name: extractorLens_rbr_knowledge_soundness
children.statement:
instance extractorLens_rbr_knowledge_soundness :
    Extractor.Lens.IsKnowledgeSound
      (relationRound R n deg D i.castSucc) (Simple.inputRelation R deg D)
      (relationRound R n deg D i.succ) (Simple.outputRelation R deg)
      ((Simple.oracleVerifier R deg D oSpec).toVerifier.compatStatement (oStmtLens R n deg D i))
      (fun _ _ => True)
      ⟨oStmtLens R n deg D i, Witness.InvLens.trivial⟩
children.closed_by: fields proj_knowledgeSound (citing verifier_polynomial and output_projection) and lift_knowledgeSound (citing input_projection)
children.note: An `instance` of Extractor.Lens.IsKnowledgeSound, not a `theorem`. Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: The oracle-statement lens is knowledge-sound for the simple verifier's compatStatement

theorem oracleVerifier_rbrKnowledgeSoundness [Fintype R] [IsDomain R] :
    (oracleVerifier R deg D oSpec).toVerifier.rbrKnowledgeSoundness init impl
    (inputRelation R deg D) (outputRelation R deg) (fun _ => (deg : ℝ≥0) / Fintype.card R)

applicability.goal_shape: A soundness/security property (here rbrKnowledgeSoundness) of a *lifted* object `X.liftContext lens output`, where the same property is already proved for the inner object `X` and for the lens itself.
applicability.use_when: there is a general transport theorem that lifts the property across a lens (here OracleVerifier.liftContext_rbrKnowledgeSoundness), an equivalence showing the target object is exactly the context-lift (oracleVerifier_eq_liftContext), a certificate that the lens is knowledge-sound (extractorLens_rbr_knowledge_soundness), and the inner object's certificate (Simple.oracleVerifier_rbrKnowledgeSoundness).
applicability.avoid_when: the lens is not executable or not knowledge-sound; the inner object's property is not already proved; the equivalence showing the target object is the context-lift cannot be stated as its own self-contained lemma and would have to be proved inline in the glue (the equivalence being a hard proof is not by itself a reason to avoid the move: here oracleVerifier_eq_liftContext is a 36-line induction, plainly not rfl/simp, yet the move works because it is a named child leaf).

claims.claim: The parent theorem `oracleVerifier_rbrKnowledgeSoundness` is declared at lines 1180-1191 of ArkLib/ProofSystem/Sumcheck/Spec/SingleRound.lean.
The parent site cites the lens certificate `extractorLens_rbr_knowledge_soundness`.

The glue (the parent site, 12 lines) is shorter than the children it cites: the three child sites are 36, 17 and 5 lines, 58 lines in total, so the argument is carried by the children and the glue only assembles them.
claims.evidence: site line ranges in entry.json: parent 1180-1191 (12 lines); children 893-928 (36), 1115-1131 (17), 583-587 (5)

claims.claim: The same move - transport the soundness bound from the simple round to the full round along the statement lens - is applied again at `verifier_rbrKnowledgeSoundness` (lines 1146-1157), with Verifier.liftContext_rbrKnowledgeSoundness in place of the oracle-verifier transport.

The blueprint documents the move: node `thm:sumcheck_single_round_soundness` names `Sumcheck.Spec.SingleRound.oracleVerifier_rbrKnowledgeSoundness` and states 'The round is obtained by lifting the virtual round below along a context lens, which transfers both properties.'

metrics.how_counted: site line ranges (declaration plus proof), taken from entry.json sites

consequences: The move turns one soundness proof into three named obligations: (1) an equivalence showing the target object is the context-lift (oracleVerifier_eq_liftContext), (2) a lens knowledge-soundness certificate (extractorLens_rbr_knowledge_soundness, with its own projection and lift fields), and (3) the inner object's certificate (Simple.oracleVerifier_rbrKnowledgeSoundness). Failure mode: the `lensKS := by simpa using extractorLens_rbr_knowledge_soundness i` argument only closes if the lens definition simplifies to the exact class instance; a lens that is not simp-normal would need its own rewrite.
